Tide Lore: Knowing when the sea gives and takes
Night Navigation: Steering by the stars
Divine Kingship: The ruler as child of the sun

Mystic Orders: Moon priests who keep the hidden calendar
Heliocentrism: The earth moves. The priests will not like it
Celestial Spheres: Heaven is perfect and fixed
